entities.summary: Chadwick Oliver Kinch was an American professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Charlotte 49ers and was selected in the 1980 NBA draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers. Kinch played for one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Cavaliers and Dallas Mavericks. He finished his basketball career with a short stint for the Reno Bighorns of the Continental Basketball Association in 1982. After his playing retirement, Kinch descended into a drug habit and eventually contracted HIV. He died of AIDS-related complications in 1994 at the age of 35.
